task_completion.description: Log in to the Odoo instance using admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the Odoo dashboard or App switcher after the login screen, indicating a successful session for 'admin'.
The VLM should see the 'Employees' app icon being clicked or the 'Employees' breadcrumb/header at the top of the page.

task_completion.description: Click the 'New' or 'Create' button to start a new employee record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see an empty employee form with fields like 'Employee Name', 'Job Position', and 'Department' ready for input.

task_completion.description: Enter 'Sarah Mitchell' as the employee name.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see 'Sarah Mitchell' typed into the name field of the employee form.

task_completion.description: Select 'Experienced Developer' as the Job Position.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see 'Experienced Developer' selected in the Job Position dropdown or field.
The VLM should see 'Research & Development' selected in the Department dropdown or field.

task_completion.description: Save the newly created employee record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking the 'Save' icon (cloud/disk) or the form transitioning from an editable state to a read-only profile view for Sarah Mitchell.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database queries or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots should show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser window, not a terminal/shell.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the UI rather than jumping directly to a deep-linked creation URL if not provided.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent clicking the Employees app icon from the main dashboard.

integrity.description: The agent manually selected or typed the required fields rather than using automated script injection.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the dropdown menus being opened and the specific values 'Experienced Developer' and 'Research & Development' being selected from the existing options.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Odoo instance is version 17.0. The job position 'Experienced Developer' and the department 'Research & Development' are pre-existing demo data and should be selectable from dropdowns. The database name is 'odoo'. The login credentials are admin/admin.
